Vector technology icons are adapted from [Devicon](https://github.com/devicons/devicon), under the MIT license in [devicon-LICENSE.txt](devicon-LICENSE.txt).

Source paths: `icons/<technology>/<technology>-original.svg` on the upstream master branch. Java artwork is also used for JSP and Servlet. SQL and Assembler use original generic database and processor symbols. Monochrome Bash and GitHub artwork is recolored for dark backgrounds.
